meta.name: pirate_unicorn_war
meta.prompt: A pirate island and a unicorn island, at war.

programs.brief: A colossal rearing unicorn colossus sculpted from smooth quartz, horn tipped with golden prismarine, standing on a fortified coastal bluff glaring down across the strait at the pirate fleet.
A menacing three-masted pirate corsair flagship bristling with dark oak gunports, weathered rigging, and broadside cannons trained directly on the unicorn citadel across the strait.
A soaring arcane warding spire radiating purpur and glowing amethyst energy, encased in pale quartz arches that channel protective shields over the sanctuary.
A fortified dark timber and sandbag artillery redoubt with twin heavy iron cannons and powder barrels aimed out across the waters.
An enchanted glowing amethyst crystal cluster mounted on an ornate white quartz pedestal, humming with defensive ward magic.

tokens.event_direction: pirate corsairs and raiding sloops bombarding the unicorn isle from the strait while the sacred bastion returns fire
tokens.region_pirate_island: era renaissance, wealth 0.35, decline 0.5, formality 0.15; materialTheme temperate_timber; formPacks [nautical_pirate]; prefer archetypes tavern, warehouse, watchtower, lighthouse; props galleon, cart; ramshackle docks, cannon batteries along the headlands, careened prize hulls, skull standards
tokens.region_unicorn_island: era renaissance, wealth 0.85, decline 0.1, formality 0.75; materialTheme white_quartz; formPacks [arcane_magical]; prefer archetypes church, manor, watchtower; flora [glow, cherry_blossom]; marble sea-bastions, fortified beacon towers, enchanted pastures, unicorn herd sanctuaries under fire
